headline: Unbeaten Lincoln catch Drury at the top
dek: Lincoln's win over Quincy on Sunday drew them level with Drury at the head of the table, with a match in hand. They are still the only side in the conference without a defeat, nine wins and four draws in all, and the two leaders meet at Drury on Saturday.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's forty-two goals are more than Lewis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have scored between them, and they have conceded thirty doing it; the goals have not bought a place near the top of the table.

wire.line: Every side but Lincoln has now lost, and Lincoln still have Missouri S&T, Drury and McKendree to play.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln remain the only programme in the conference yet to lose: nine wins and four draws, twenty-five goals scored and nine conceded, the latest win coming at home to Quincy on Sunday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored twenty-two goals and conceded twenty-four, and Jacob Panagos has thirteen of the twenty-two from forty-four shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Noah Nymark-Pedersen has made sixty-nine saves for Upper Iowa and conceded thirty, a save percentage of .697.

last_match.line: Lincoln are still without a defeat; Quincy have drawn more matches than any other side in the conference.

next_match.line: Missouri S&T are the only side to have beaten Drury in conference play; Lincoln have not lost to anyone.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
